 Competition: La Liga Stage: Regular Season, 12 Date: 06 Nov 2026 Time: 20:00 UTC Stadium: Estadio Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán Sevilla vs Deportivo Alavés Preview
 Sevilla sit sixth in La Liga with 17 points, five clear of their visitors, and Luis García Plaza's men have shown flashes of real quality at the Ramón Sánchez Pizjuán. A convincing 3-0 Copa del Rey triumph on October 29th provided a timely confidence boost after a bruising 1-4 loss to Real Madrid. Their recent league form has been inconsistent, with two wins sandwiched around a draw and two defeats, but home advantage could prove decisive.
 Deportivo Alavés arrive in seventh place on 12 points, yet Quique Flores will know his side's away record this season is a genuine concern; they are yet to claim a single league victory on the road. A 1-1 draw against Málaga on October 23rd extended a winless run of four matches. With a trip to Barcelona looming shortly after, fatigue and squad rotation could further complicate their preparations for this crucial encounter in Seville.
 Sevilla's home advantage is central to this selection. The hosts have won two of their last five matches, including a commanding Copa del Rey victory, and their Sánchez Pizjuán fortress gives them a clear edge over an Alavés side yet to win away in La Liga this season. Backing the double chance, covered by the home win at 2.05 , provides a safety net against the draw.
 Alavés have claimed three wins from the last six head-to-head meetings, a record that makes a straight Sevilla win too risky. Quique Flores's side drew their most recent outing against Málaga and have shown resilience in tight contests. That historical competitiveness justifies widening the selection to include the draw at 3.48 rather than relying solely on the hosts.
 The under 2.5 goals market at 1.73 also merits attention. Alavés have drawn three of their last five fixtures, suggesting low-scoring, cagey affairs suit their style. Sevilla's inconsistency, punctuated by a heavy defeat to Real Madrid, indicates they can be subdued on occasion. A tight encounter at the Pizjuán, with Sevilla avoiding defeat, aligns with a 58% confidence level for this 1X pick.
